DATE Thursday, Sept. 3, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET CALL PARTICIPANTS Chief Investor Relations Officer - Joshua Levine president and chief executive officer - Mick J. Beekhuizen chief financial officer - Todd E. Cunfer TAKEAWAYS Net Sales -- $2.137 billion in the fourth quarter, representing an 8% decrease primarily due to lapping an extra week in the prior fiscal year. Organic Net Sales -- Declined 1% in the fourth quarter, reflecting lower volume/mix across the portfolio. Adjusted EBIT -- $242 million in the fourth quarter, a 25% decrease including an 8% impact from the extra week in the prior year period. Adjusted EPS -- $0.39 in the fourth quarter, down from $0.62 in the prior year period. Quarterly Dividend -- $0.25 per share, representing a 36% reduction to accelerate the reduction of debt on the balance sheet. Full-Year Net Sales -- $9.744 billion for fiscal 2026, representing a 5% decrease compared to the previous fiscal year. Cash Flow From Operations -- $1.039 billion for the full fiscal year, down from $1.131 billion in the prior year. New Cost Savings Program -- $500 million in targeted savings by fiscal 2030, which includes $350 million in incremental savings and $150 million remaining from the prior program. FY 2027 Organic Net Sales Guidance -- (4)% to (2)%, reflecting an external environment management expects will remain volatile. FY 2027 Adjusted EPS Guidance -- $1.65 to $1.80, with the La Regina acquisition expected to have a neutral impact. Impairment Charges -- $117 million, recognized in the fourth quarter on the Kettle Brand and Cape Cod trademarks within the Snacks segment. Meals & Beverages Organic Net Sales -- Increased 3% in the fourth quarter, including a 2-percentage-point tailwind from the prior year SAP implementation for Sovos Brands. Snacks Organic Net Sales -- Declined 6% in the fourth quarter, driven by unfavorable volume/mix in the salty portfolio and third-party partner brands. Fiscal 2027 Inflation Outlook -- 5% to 6% expected for the full year, with logistics costs projected to increase in the double digits. Capital Expenditures -- $361 million for fiscal 2026, compared to $426 million in the prior year. Segment Operating Earnings -- Declined 12% in Meals & Beverages and 34% in Snacks during the fourth quarter. Gross Margin Guidance -- Projected to decrease 50 to 100 basis points for fiscal 2027, with significant pressure expected in the first quarter. Interest Expense Guidance -- Approximately $25 million higher year over year in fiscal 2027, driven by the La Regina acquisition and refinancing activities. Price Realization -- 1% across the company in fiscal 2026, with management communicating additional price increases on approximately 60% of the portfolio for fiscal 2027. Elasticity Assumption -- 1.5x, utilized by management to model the impact of planned pricing actions on volume. La Regina Acquisition -- $286 million total consideration for a 49% interest, with $146 million paid in cash and $140 million due in May 2027. Inventory Productivity -- $225 million achieved under the prior $375 million savings program, including $25 million delivered in the fourth quarter. Need a quote from a Motley Fool analyst? Email [email protected] RISKS CFO Cunfer stated, "Q1 for Snacks is going to be very, very challenging," noting that high single-digit sales declines and fixed cost deleverage will impact first-quarter results. Cunfer warned that the company expects "another year of elevated inflation" and a "volatile" external environment through fiscal 2027. Cunfer stated, "gross margin for the total year, probably down 50 to 100 basis points," citing negative price realization in the first quarter and broad-based inflation. SUMMARY Management of The Campbell's Company ( CPB -4.30% ) reported fiscal 2026 results that fell below internal objectives, citing top-line softness and inflation-driven margin pressure. The company announced a strategic reset involving a 36% dividend reduction to prioritize balance sheet strengthening and debt repayment. Management launched a multiyear $500 million cost savings initiative focused on procurement, supply chain optimization, and headcount reductions. For fiscal 2027, the company expects sequential margin improvement following a challenging first quarter, supported by new innovation in the soup and snacks portfolios. CEO Beekhuizen noted that the cooking side of the soup portfolio is performing well, with retail sales exposed to cooking growing at a 5% compound annual growth rate over the last four years. The company is focusing on "semi-scratch" cooking trends, which Beekhuizen defined as meals requiring fewer than 30 minutes of prep time and five ingredients or less. Management indicated that 80% of inflation exposure is covered for the first half of fiscal 2027, but coverage decreases to 50% for the second half. The company is considering a hybrid bond issuance to refinance a $500 million maturing bond, which would provide 50% equity credit. CEO Beekhuizen stated, "within Goldfish, we are focused on households with kids, and as you have seen in our Q4 results, we are seeing some encouraging trends within Goldfish." The company plans to launch Goldfish Gluten-Free in the first half of fiscal 2027 as part of a "better-for-you" innovation strategy. INDUSTRY GLOSSARY Adjusted EBIT : A non-GAAP financial measure that excludes the impact of restructuring charges, mark-to-market adjustments, and other items not considered part of ongoing operations. DSD : Direct-store-delivery, a distribution model where products are delivered directly to retail stores rather than through a central warehouse. Organic Net Sales : Net sales excluding the impact of currency, acquisitions, divestitures, and the additional week in fiscal 2025. RGM : Revenue growth management, a data-driven approach to optimizing pricing, trade spending, and portfolio mix. RTS : Ready-to-serve, a category of soups that do not require additional liquid before consumption. Semi-scratch : A cooking method where prepared food products are used as a base and combined with fresh ingredients to create a meal. Sovos Brands : The company acquired by Campbell's in 2024, which includes the Rao's and Michael Angelo's brands.
